info.title: DNSY REST API
info.description: Management API of the DNSY DNS server. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

post.summary: Create the first admin with the one-time code printed at startup.
Log in with username and password; sets the session and CSRF cookies.
End the current session and clear the cookies.

put.summary: Change the caller's password. Ends all sessions and starts a new one for this client.

403.description: A file path or private target needs the admin scope

422.description: Invalid source or SSRF target refused

204.description: Deleted; its entries leave the filter

422.description: The fetch failed; the previous list stays active

delete.summary: Remove the entries of one name, optionally with its subtree. Needs `api:write`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Domain name whose entries are removed.

parameters.name: subtree
parameters.description: Also remove everything below the name (default false).

get.summary: Search the query log, newest first.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Exact client address (the network address when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the query name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type by name (`A`, `AAAA`, ...) or number.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Response code by name (`NOERROR`, `NXDOMAIN`, ...) or number.

get.summary: Live tail of the query log as server-sent events.
get.description:
Events are named `query` and carry one log record as JSON; `lagged` means rows were
skipped because the consumer was too slow. The server polls at its own pace, so a slow
consumer never makes it buffer. The number of concurrent streams is capped (429 beyond).
Takes the same filters as the search (`from`/`to` bound the stream). Needs `api:write`
(operator or admin).

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Exact client address (the network address when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the query name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type by name (`A`, `AAAA`, ...) or number.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Response code by name (`NOERROR`, `NXDOMAIN`, ...) or number.

422.description: Unknown field or invalid value; nothing changed

get.summary: Totals, answer sources, DNSSEC status counts, cache hit ratio, blocked ratio and latency.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: Query counts per bucket (only buckets with data), oldest first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket width in seconds, a multiple of 60 (default 3600).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: Busiest clients (network addresses when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: List the caller's tokens; admins see everyone's.

post.summary: Create a token for the caller. Needs a session, so a token cannot mint tokens.

201.description: Created; the secret is in this response only

403.description: Not a session, or a scope the role does not allow

delete.summary: Revoke a token (own tokens; admins any).

503.description: The server is not running upstream groups

422.description: A group keeps at least one member

delete.summary: Delete a user. Their tokens and sessions go with them.

patch.summary: Change a user's role and/or reset the password.

get.summary: Get a zone, with its `load_error` and an `ETag`.

put.summary: Replace a zone's settings and records. The DNSSEC policy is kept; the serial is bumped.

delete.summary: Delete a zone and its file.

get.summary: Download the zone as a BIND master file.
List records of a zone (paged). The SOA is part of the zone detail, not listed here.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only this owner name (relative or absolute).

post.summary: Add a record. The SOA serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, or a CNAME conflict

put.summary: Replace a record. The id changes when name, type or value change. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, a CNAME conflict, or the last apex NS removed

delete.summary: Delete a record. The apex keeps at least one NS record. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: The last apex NS record cannot be removed

get.summary: The process can serve requests (the database answers).

default_action.description: Applied to clients no rule matches.

rate_limit_qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 means unlimited.

cidr.description: Network the rule matches (host bits cleared), for address rules.

client_cert_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of an mTLS client certificate, for identity rules.

Action.description: What to do with a matching client.

BlocklistView.description: A blocklist source and the status of its last fetch.

allow_private.description: Private and loopback targets (and file paths) are allowed for this source.

entries.description: Entries loaded from the last successful fetch.

last_fetched.description: Unix seconds of the last fetch attempt.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last fetch attempt.

code.description: The one-time code printed to stderr at startup.

max_ttl.description: Highest TTL (seconds) given to cached positive answers.

min_ttl.description: Lowest TTL (seconds) given to cached positive answers.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; the certificate is refused from then on.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the DER certificate, lowercase hex.

CreateAclRule.description: New rule: exactly one of `cidr` and `client_cert_sha256`.

cidr.description: Address or network, e.g. `203.0.113.7` or `10.0.0.0/8` (longest prefix wins).

client_cert_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex digits) of an mTLS client certificate.

allow_private.description: Allow private, loopback and link-local targets. Needs the `admin` scope.

location.description: `http://` or `https://` URL, or a file path (file paths need the `admin` scope).

expires_at.description: Unix seconds in the future; omit for no expiry.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint: 64 hex digits, optionally colon separated.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. `ads.example.com`; subdomains match too.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; omit for a token that does not expire.

scopes.description: Must be allowed by the caller's role.

CreatedToken.description: The only response that contains the token secret.

token.description: The secret. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

GroupBody.description: Group definition for create and replace.

default.description: Receives queries no domain pattern matches. Exactly one group is the default.

GroupView.description: A group with its members and, when the server is running, their health.

available.description: Not ejected by the passive health check.

latency_ms.description: Smoothed round-trip time; absent until measured.

per_client_qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 means unlimited.

LogPageBody.description: A page of the query log, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

client.description: Client address (truncated to its network when redaction is on).

principal.description: Authenticated principal (`DoH` token name), never a token secret.

MemberInput.description: A member as written by a client.

weight.description: Used by the `weighted` strategy; 1 to 1000, default 1.

PatchBlocklist.description: Fields of a source that can change.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence. Never contains secrets.

retry_after_secs.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (only on 429).

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 disables limiting. At most 1,000,000.

warnings.description:
Conditions that do not stop serving but need attention. `dnssec_clock_untrusted`: the
system clock is before the build time, so DNSSEC validation is suspended.

RecordInput.description: A record as written by a client.

name.description: `@`, a name relative to the zone, or an absolute name ending in a dot.

ttl.description: Seconds; defaults to the zone default TTL.

type.description: A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, PTR, MX, TXT, SRV or CAA.

total.description: Records matching the filters, across all pages.

id.description: Stable id: hash of owner name, type and value.

entries.description: Block plus allow entries now loaded (only when `updated`).

RuleView.description: A custom rule: the domain and everything below it. Allow beats block.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial update: omitted fields keep their value.

SettingsView.description: The settings that can change at runtime.

SoaBody.description: The SOA record of a zone.

rname.description: Responsible mailbox, as a domain name.

serial.description: Initial serial on create (default 1). Ignored on replace: every write bumps the serial.

ttl.description: TTL of the SOA record; defaults to the zone default TTL.

StrategyView.description: How a group orders its members.

blocked.description: Answers blocked by a blocklist or rule.

blocked_ratio.description: `blocked / total`, 0 when there are no queries.

TokenInfo.description: Token metadata. The secret is never part of it.

UpdateUser.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

password.description: Reset the password (at least 8 characters); ends all of the user's sessions.

role.description: Changing the role ends all of the user's sessions.

UserInfo.description: A user account. Never carries password material.

ZoneBody.description: Settings and records of a zone, for create and replace.

records.description: Must contain at least one NS record at the apex.

ZoneDetail.description: A zone with its SOA (no records; see `/zones/{name}/records`).

load_error.description: Why the zone file on disk is not being served, if its latest version is invalid.
